body.objective: Construct or obstruct the certified minimal four-row repair of the Berger global-rod time-translation closure: two new global scalar rods and their two cyclic cotangents.

Add exactly two real degree-zero global scalar rods and two degree-one cyclic cotangents through one declared action-derived or cotangent-lifted local/global sector.  Recompute the co-rotating rod background, stress tensor, Phi2 source, background equations, odd pairing, real structure, K_Berger action and complete 112-row unary differential.  Verify q1^2=0, cyclicity, [K_Berger,q1]=0, background quotient closure, support/zero-mode typing and that the original 108-row carrier embeds by an explicit chain map.  Prove the eight-dimensional closure rank is now complete or exhibit the first later incompatibility.  Establish minimality by replaying the six-rod rank-eight obstruction and rejecting every one-rod/one-cotangent or wrong-degree repair.  Export exact rows, action/pairing hashes and a method-distinct verifier.
body.current_gate: action-derived 112-row global-rod unary complex with complete K_Berger closure
body.forbid: no ad hoc rows without an action/cotangent origin; no apparatus first-order rods substituted for second-order global rods; no raw direct sum; no q2/q3, cohomology, Z2, memory, redshift, positivity or quantum promotion before unary closure
activates: or an exact later-page obstruction and its minimal enlargement
